heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2090636:2102.Aug. 10, 1982, Pub. L. 97–234, § 2, 96 Stat. 261. The words “and subject to the laws of such State or States” are omitted as unnecessary.
